#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Concatenate each day's question PNG and solution PNG vertically.

For every day{N} directory containing both day{N}.png and day{N}_solution.png,
writes day{N}/day{N}_combined.png with the question stacked on top of the
solution. Images are scaled to a common width (the wider of the two) before
stacking so mismatched resolutions don't look skewed.
"""

import re
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def combine(question_path: Path, solution_path: Path, output_path: Path) -> None:
    question = Image.open(question_path)
    solution = Image.open(solution_path)

    width = max(question.width, solution.width)

    def scale_to_width(img: Image.Image, target_width: int) -> Image.Image:
        if img.width == target_width:
            return img
        new_height = round(img.height * target_width / img.width)
        return img.resize((target_width, new_height), Image.LANCZOS)

    question = scale_to_width(question, width)
    solution = scale_to_width(solution, width)

    combined = Image.new("RGB", (width, question.height + solution.height), "white")
    combined.paste(question, (0, 0))
    combined.paste(solution, (0, question.height))
    combined.save(output_path)
    print(f"wrote {output_path.relative_to(ROOT)} ({width}x{combined.height})")


def main() -> None:
    day_dirs = sorted(
        (p for p in ROOT.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and re.fullmatch(r"day\d+", p.name)),
        key=lambda p: int(p.name[3:]),
    )

    for day_dir in day_dirs:
        day = day_dir.name
        question_path = day_dir / f"{day}.png"
        solution_path = day_dir / f"{day}_solution.png"
        output_path = day_dir / f"{day}_combined.png"

        if not question_path.exists() or not solution_path.exists():
            print(f"skip {day}: missing question or solution png")
            continue

        combine(question_path, solution_path, output_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
